pchickey opened PR #15181 from pchickey:cargo_update_futures to bytecodealliance:main:

futures 0.3.31 has a transitive dependency on pin-utils, which is just had a RUSTSEC go out that it is unmaintained. updating to futures 0.3.34 fixes that issue, all other changes in that upgrade are inconsequential.

Closes https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasmtime/issues/15177
